partially_covered.missing: Organization details limited to address, postal code, city, country code, and GLN. Still no legal name, contact info, or identifier granularity (e.g., VAT, registration number).
Item details lack product code, description, and unit of measure. Only presence of Item class and linkage via InvoiceLine is modeled.
ValidationConstraint class exists, but no explicit OWL cardinality or SHACL-like constraints for mandatory D96A fields or identifier requirements.

cq_coverage.details: Coverage remains strong for most CQs, but CQ5, CQ8, and CQ13 are still only partially addressed due to lack of richer organization/item attributes and explicit validation rules. No new CQs were fully covered compared to iteration 1.

issues: xsd:string is still used for :hasDate; should be xsd:dateTime for OWL 2 DL compliance.
Some inverse properties (e.g., :isRoleAssignmentOf, :isRoleAssignedTo, :isOrganizationAssigned, etc.) still lack rdfs:label and rdfs:comment.

strengths: Deep class hierarchy reflecting EDIFACT structure
Consistent use of restrictions and inverses
weaknesses: No General Class Axioms (GCAs) or owl:equivalentClass for richer semantics

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7: Use of non-standard datatype (xsd:string for date)
reasoner_risks: Hermit and Pellet will fail OWL 2 DL conformance due to xsd:string used for :hasDate (should be xsd:dateTime).

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Change the range of :hasDate from xsd:string to xsd:dateTime to comply with OWL 2 DL datatype map.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables reasoner compatibility and OWL 2 DL conformance.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add rdfs:label and rdfs:comment to all inverse properties and any missing object/data properties.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves ontology readability and validator scores.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand :Organization and :Item with additional attributes (e.g., legal name, contact info, product code, unit of measure) to fully answer CQ5 and CQ8.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables more granular queries and semantic interoperability.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Model SHACL-like constraints or OWL restrictions for mandatory fields and D96A compliance (e.g., cardinality, required identifiers).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improves CQ13 coverage and supports automated validation.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add GCAs and owl:equivalentClass axioms to define key concepts (e.g., Buyer as OrganizationRoleAssignment with assignedRole Buyer).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enables advanced reasoning and richer semantic definitions.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add more disjointness axioms among segment, section, and role classes for semantic clarity.

summary: The ontology remains robust in its structural modeling of EDIFACT and covers the majority of competency questions. However, no significant progress was made on high-priority issues: the use of xsd:string for dates persists, and inverse property annotations are still incomplete. Most previous improvement suggestions were not addressed, so quality and coverage scores are unchanged. Further work is required to achieve OWL 2 DL compliance and full CQ coverage.

suggestions_ignored: Add rdfs:label and rdfs:comment to all inverse properties
improvement_tracking.notes: None of the high- or medium-priority suggestions from the previous review were implemented. The ontology remains strong in its structure but is stalled on compliance, annotation, and attribute enrichment.
